fran_kim: Quick report from onboarding: the sampleapp batcher produced a missing vector in a 2-item embeddings batch when a token refresh happened. Single curl never fails; only SDK batcher.

sam_sdk: Can you share a minimal repro and confirm you're using the sampleapp batcher?

fran_kim: Using sampleapp helper. Repro: POST /v1/embeddings/batch with inputs ["x", "y"] and force token expiry before send. Observed response sometimes: { results: [ {embedding: [...]}, null ] } — no error field.

ira_infra: This matches an auth-refresh partial-replay race we've seen. If the client refreshes mid-batch the retry wrapper may replay a fragment; server merges fragments but client zipper assumes positional indexing and inserts placeholders for missing slots.

sam_sdk: Short-term fix: annotate each input with a stable client_id (nanoid) and reassemble response by client_id instead of array index; also retry whole batch once if any null/empty entries are returned.

fran_kim: Confirmed: client_id remap + retry-on-null removed the flake in 5k forced runs.

ellie_docs: I'll add a troubleshooting blurb to onboarding: enable BATCHER_SAFE_BY_ID and upgrade SDKs if you see null/empty vectors. Filing DOCS-600.

ira_infra: Long-term: add single-flight auth refresh, make retry wrapper replay full batches not fragments, and consider server-side validation to reject fragment merges missing client_ids. Filed INFRA-999.

ci-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sdk-node/pulls/1417 — "batcher: client_id remap, fail-safe retry, normalize embedding/vector". CI queued.

sam_sdk: Also noting inconsistency: embeddings use \"embedding\" field, rerank often uses \"vector\". SDKs should accept both and normalize to an internal name to avoid parity bugs.

fran_kim: Thanks — leaving follow-ups on PR and docs ticket. Ping me if CI shows regressions. :thumbsup:
